ko.title: 기계 뒤에 숨겨진 금속: 희토류와 핵심 광물이 지리학적 분쟁 원인이 되는 이유

segments.src: Every electric car, wind turbine, smartphone and guided missile contains materials most people never think about.
segments.tr: 모든 전기차, 풍력 터빈, 스마트폰, 유도 미사일에는 대부분의 사람들이 생각조차 해보지 않은 원자재가 들어 있습니다.

segments.src: Rare earth elements, lithium, cobalt, graphite, gallium and a handful of other critical minerals sit deep inside modern supply chains.
segments.tr: 희토류 원소, 리튬, 코발트, 흑연, 갈륨 및 기타 일부 핵심 광물은 현대 공급망의 깊숙한 곳에 위치하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Because production and processing of many of them are concentrated in just a few countries, they have become a recurring point of tension in trade policy and national security planning.
segments.tr: 이들 중 상당수의 생산과 가공이 일부 국가에 집중되어 있기 때문에, 무역 정책과 안보 계획에서 반복적인 긴장 요인으로 부상했습니다.

segments.src: ## What are "critical minerals" and rare earths?
segments.tr: ## "핵심 광물"과 희토류란 무엇인가?

segments.src: "Critical minerals" is a policy label, not a scientific category.
segments.tr: "핵심 광물"은 과학적 분류라기보다는 정책적 용어입니다.

segments.src: Governments, including the United States, the European Union, Japan and Australia, maintain lists of materials that are both important to their economies and vulnerable to supply disruption.
segments.tr: 미국, 유럽연합, 일본, 아우스트랄리아를 포함한 정부들은 경제에 중요하면서도 공급 차질에 취약한 원자재 목록을 관리합니다.

segments.src: The lists differ, but they commonly include lithium, cobalt, nickel, graphite, manganese, gallium, germanium and the group known as rare earth elements.
segments.tr: 목록은 국가마다 다르지만, 일반적으로 리튬, 코발트, 니켈, 흑연, 망간, 갈륨, 게르마늄 및 희토류 원소로 알려진 그룹을 포함합니다.

segments.src: Despite the name, rare earths are not especially scarce in the Earth's crust.
segments.tr: 이름과 달리, 희토류는 지구 지각에 특별히 희귀하게 존재하지 않습니다.

segments.src: The challenge is that they are rarely found in concentrations that are easy and economical to mine, and separating them from one another is a complex, chemically intensive process that can generate significant waste.
segments.tr: 문제는 채굴이 쉽고 경제적인 농도로 존재하는 경우가 드물고, 이들을 서로 분리하는 과정이 복잡하고 화학 반응이 많이 요구되어 상당한 폐기물을 발생시킬 수 있다는 점입니다.

segments.src: ## Where they show up in everyday products
segments.tr: ## 일상 제품에서 쓰이는 곳

segments.src: - **Magnets:** Neodymium and praseodymium are used in high-strength permanent magnets. These appear in electric vehicle motors, wind turbine generators, hard drives, headphones and many industrial robots. Dysprosium and terbium are added to help magnets withstand heat.
segments.tr: - **영구자석:** 네오디뮴과 프라세오디뮴은 고강도 영구자석에 사용됩니다. 이는 전기차 모터, 풍력 터빈 발전기, 하드 드라이브, 헤드폰 및 많은 산업용 로봇에 적용됩니다. 디스프로슘과 터븀은 자석이 열을 견딜 수 있도록 돕기 위해 첨가됩니다.

segments.src: - **Batteries:** Lithium, nickel, cobalt, manganese and graphite are central to most lithium-ion batteries, which power vehicles, laptops, phones and grid storage systems.
segments.tr: - **배터리:** 리튬, 니켈, 코발트, 망간, 흑연은 차량, 노트북, 전화기 및 전력망 저장 시스템에 전력을 공급하는 대부분의 리튬이온 배터리의 핵심입니다.

segments.src: - **Chips and electronics:** Gallium and germanium are used in certain semiconductors, power electronics, fiber optics and infrared sensors. Many other specialty metals play smaller but essential roles in manufacturing.
segments.tr: - **칩과 전자제품:** 갈륨과 게르마늄은 특정 반도체, 전력 전자 장치, 광섬유 및 적외선 센서에 사용됩니다. 기타 많은 특수 금속들도 제조 분야에서 작지만 필수적인 역할을 수행합니다.

segments.src: - **Defense systems:** Radar, sonar, precision guidance, jet engines and communications equipment rely on specialty magnets and alloys.
segments.tr: - **방위 시스템:** 레이더, 소나, 정밀 유도, 제트 엔진 및 통신 장비는 특수 자석과 합금에 의존합니다.

segments.src: ## Why concentration matters
segments.tr: ## 집중도가 중요한 이유

segments.src: The key issue is not only who mines these materials, but who refines them.
segments.tr: 핵심 문제는 누가 이 원자재를 채굴하느냐뿐만 아니라, 누가 정제하느냐입니다.

segments.src: Mining may be spread across several countries, yet a large share of processing capacity for many minerals, especially rare earth separation and magnet manufacturing, has been concentrated in China, according to analyses from the International Energy Agency and other agencies.
segments.tr: 국제에너지기구(IEA) 및 기타 기관의 분석에 따르면 채굴은 여러 국가에 분산되어 있을 수 있지만, 많은 광물, 특히 희토류 분리 및 자석 제조를 위한 가공 용량의 상당 부분이 중국에 집중되어 있습니다.

segments.src: Other pieces of the chain are concentrated elsewhere: the Democratic Republic of the Congo supplies a large portion of the world's cobalt, and Indonesia has become the leading nickel producer.
segments.tr: 공급망의 다른 부분은 다른 곳에 집중되어 있습니다: 콩고민주공화국은 세계 코발트 공급량의 상당 부분을 차지하고 있으며, 인도네시아는 주요 니켈 생산국이 되었습니다.

segments.src: When so much of a supply chain depends on a small number of countries or facilities, any disruption can ripple outward.
segments.tr: 공급망의 많은 부분이 소수의 국가나 시설에 의존할 때, 조그만 차질이라도 외부로 파급될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That disruption might come from a trade dispute, a policy change, a natural disaster, a labor problem or a political conflict.
segments.tr: 그러한 차질은 무역 분쟁, 정책 변화, 자연재해, 노동 문제 또는 정치적 갈등에서 발생할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Even the possibility of disruption can push companies and governments to rethink how they source materials.
segments.tr: 차질이 발생할 가능성만으로도 기업과 정부는 원자재 조달 방식을 재검토하게 됩니다.

segments.src: ## Export controls: a policy tool with consequences
segments.tr: ## 수출 통제: 여파를 동반하는 정책 도구

segments.src: Export controls restrict or require licenses for shipments of certain goods or technologies.
segments.tr: 수출 통제는 특정 상품이나 기술의 출하를 제한하거나 라이선스를 요구합니다.

segments.src: In recent years, several countries have introduced or expanded controls on minerals and related processing technology.
segments.tr: 최근 수년간 여러 국가가 광물 및 관련 가공 기술에 대한 통제를 도입하거나 확대했습니다.

segments.src: China, for example, has applied licensing requirements to exports of gallium, germanium, graphite and some rare earth products and magnets.
segments.tr: 예를 들어 중국은 갈륨, 게르마늄, 흑연 및 일부 희토류 제품과 자석의 수출에 라이선스 요건을 적용했습니다.

segments.src: Other governments have used their own controls on advanced chips and manufacturing equipment, which in turn has shaped the broader trade debate.
segments.tr: 다른 정부들은 첨단 칩과 제조 장비에 대해 자국만의 통제를 시행했으며, 이는 광범위한 무역 논의를 형성했습니다.

segments.src: Officials who impose such rules typically cite national security, environmental protection or compliance with international obligations.
segments.tr: 이러한 규칙을 부과하는 당국자들은 보통 국가 안보, 환경 보호 또는 국제 의무 준수를 이유로 듭니다.

segments.src: Importing countries and manufacturers often view them as a source of uncertainty.
segments.tr: 수입국과 제조업체는 이를 불확실성의 원인으로 보는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: Whatever the motive, the practical effect is that buyers may face longer lead times, paperwork, higher prices or a need to find alternative suppliers.
segments.tr: 동기가 무엇이든 실질적인 효과는 구매자가 더 긴 리드 타임, 행정 절차, 더 높은 가격 또는 대체 공급업체를 찾아야 하는 필요성에 직면할 수 있다는 점입니다.

segments.src: The details of these measures change over time, so readers following the topic should check current government announcements.
segments.tr: 이러한 조치의 세부 사항은 시간에 따라 변하므로 이 주제를 따르는 독자는 최신 정부 발표를 확인해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## Stockpiling and strategic reserves
segments.tr: ## 비축 및 전략물자 준비

segments.src: Stockpiling is an old idea that is getting new attention.
segments.tr: 비축은 새로운 관심을 받고 있는 오래된 아이디어입니다.

segments.src: Japan has long maintained reserves of rare metals through a government-backed agency.
segments.tr: 일본은 정부 지원 기관을 통해 오랫동안 희유금속 비축량을 유지해 왔습니다.

segments.src: The United States keeps a National Defense Stockpile, and the European Union has discussed building strategic reserves and coordinating purchases.
segments.tr: 미국은 국방비축물자(National Defense Stockpile)를 보유하고 있으며, 유럽연합은 전략적 비축량 구축 및 공동 구매 조율을 논의해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Several governments have also considered or launched programs to fund domestic inventories of the materials most important to defense and clean energy.
segments.tr: 여러 정부는 방위 및 청정에너지에 가장 중요한 원자재의 국내 재고를 지원하기 위한 프로그램을 검토하거나 시작했습니다.

segments.src: Stockpiles can cushion short-term shocks, but they have limits.
segments.tr: 비축은 단기적인 충격을 완화할 수 있지만 한계가 있습니다.

segments.src: Storing materials costs money, some products degrade or become outdated, and a reserve cannot replace a long-term supply chain.
segments.tr: 원자재를 보관하는 데는 비용이 들고, 일부 제품은 성능이 저하되거나 구식이 되며, 비축품이 장기적인 공급망을 대체할 수는 없습니다.

segments.src: Analysts generally describe stockpiles as one tool among several rather than a complete solution.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 일반적으로 비축을 완전한 해결책이라기보다는 여러 도구 중 하나로 설명합니다.

segments.src: ## New mining deals and the race to diversify
segments.tr: ## 새로운 광산 계약 및 다변화 경쟁

segments.src: Governments and companies are pursuing partnerships to broaden supply.
segments.tr: 정부와 기업들은 공급을 확대하기 위한 파트너십을 추진하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Examples of the trend include:
segments.tr: 이러한 추세의 예는 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Government agreements:** The United States, the EU, Japan, Australia, Canada and others have signed memoranda and frameworks on critical minerals cooperation, sometimes alongside financing and shared standards.
segments.tr: - **정부 간 협정:** 미국, EU, 일본, 호주, 캐나다 등은 자금 조달 및 공통 기준과 함께 핵심 광물 협력에 대한 양해각서 및 프레임워크에 서명했습니다.

segments.src: - **Investment in new projects:** Mines and processing plants are being developed or expanded in Australia, Canada, the United States, parts of Africa and Latin America, and elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **신규 프로젝트 투자:** 호주, 캐나다, 미국, 아프리카 및 라틴 아메리카의 일부 지역, 그리고 기타 지역에서 광산 및 가공 공장이 개발되거나 확장되고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Offtake agreements and public financing:** Automakers and manufacturers have signed long-term purchase contracts, while public lenders and development banks have backed projects that private markets might consider too risky.
segments.tr: - **오프테이크(선구매) 계약 및 공공 자금 조달:** 자동차 제조사 및 생산 업체들은 장기 구매 계약을 체결했으며, 공공 대출 기관과 개발 은행은 민간 시장이 너무 위험하다고 간주할 수 있는 프로젝트를 지원했습니다.

segments.src: - **Recycling and substitution:** Companies are working on recovering metals from used batteries and magnets, and engineers are designing motors and batteries that use fewer constrained materials.
segments.tr: - **재활용 및 대체:** 기업들은 사용된 배터리와 자석에서 금속을 회수하는 작업을 진행 중이며, 엔지니어들은 제약이 많은 원자재를 덜 사용하는 모터와 배터리를 설계하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Building a new mine or refinery is slow.
segments.tr: 새로운 광산이나 정련소를 건설하는 것은 느린 과정입니다.

segments.src: It can take a decade or more to move from discovery to production, with permitting, financing, community consultation and environmental review along the way.
segments.tr: 발굴에서 생산에 이르기까지 인허가, 자금 조달, 지역사회 의견 수렴, 환경 영향 평가 등을 거치며 10년 이상 걸릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That timeline means diversification is a long-term effort, and near-term supply can remain tight even when new projects are announced.
segments.tr: 이러한 타임라인은 다변화가 장기적인 노력임을 의미하며, 새로운 프로젝트가 발표되더라도 단기 공급은 타이트하게 유지될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## How this reaches car prices
segments.tr: ## 이것이 자동차 가격에 미치는 영향

segments.src: Battery packs represent a large share of the cost of an electric vehicle, and magnet-equipped motors are used in most of them.
segments.tr: 배터리 팩은 전기차 비용의 큰 비중을 차지하며, 대부분의 전기차에 자석이 장착된 모터가 사용됩니다.

segments.src: Gasoline and hybrid vehicles use these materials too, in sensors, motors, speakers and power steering systems.
segments.tr: 가솔린 및 하이브리드 차량도 센서, 모터, 스피커 및 파워 스티어링 시스템에 이러한 원자재를 사용합니다.

segments.src: When mineral prices rise or supply tightens, manufacturers may absorb some of the cost, pass it on to buyers, redesign components or slow production.
segments.tr: 광물 가격이 오르거나 공급이 줄어들면 제조업체는 비용의 일부를 흡수하거나, 구매자에게 떠넘기거나, 부품을 재설계하거나, 생산을 감축할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Price swings have been notable in recent years.
segments.tr: 최근 수년간 가격 변동이 두드러졌습니다.

segments.src: Lithium prices, for instance, rose sharply during the early 2020s and then fell significantly as new supply arrived, illustrating how volatile these markets can be.
segments.tr: 예를 들어 리튬 가격은 2020년대 초반 급등했다가 새로운 공급이 이루어지면서 크게 하락하여 이러한 시장이 얼마나 변동성이 큰지 보여주었습니다.

segments.src: For consumers, the effect is usually indirect and delayed, showing up in vehicle pricing, available options or waiting times rather than as a line item on a sticker.
segments.tr: 소비자에게 미치는 영향은 대개 간접적이고 지연되어 나타나며, 가격표의 항목이 아니라 차량 가격 설정, 선택 가능한 옵션 또는 대기 기간으로 표시됩니다.

segments.src: ## Why defense planners care
segments.tr: ## 국방 기획자들이 관심을 갖는 이유

segments.src: Modern military equipment depends on high-performance magnets, specialty alloys and electronic components.
segments.tr: 현대 군사 장비는 고성능 자석, 특수 합금 및 전자 부품에 의존합니다.

segments.src: Defense officials in several countries have flagged that relying on a limited set of foreign suppliers for these inputs is a vulnerability.
segments.tr: 여러 국가의 국방 당국자들은 이러한 입력재를 제한된 해외 공급업체에 의존하는 것이 취약점이라고 지적해 왔습니다.

segments.src: This is one reason that mineral policy has moved from the trade desk to national security discussions, and why some defense budgets now include support for domestic processing and magnet production.
segments.tr: 이것이 광물 정책이 무역 담당 부서에서 국가 안보 논의로 이동한 이유 중 하나이며, 일부 국방 예산에 이제 국내 가공 및 자석 생산 지원이 포함되는 이유입니다.

segments.src: ## Tech supply chains and the semiconductor connection
segments.tr: ## 기술 공급망 및 반도체 연계

segments.src: Chipmaking is a global relay race involving design, materials, equipment, fabrication and packaging across many countries.
segments.tr: 반도체 제조는 여러 국가에 걸쳐 설계, 원자재, 장비, 제조 및 패키징이 포함되는 글로벌 이어달리기 경주입니다.

segments.src: Specialty metals and gases form only a small part of the finished product's cost, but a shortage of a single input can halt a production line.
segments.tr: 특수 금속과 가스는 완제품 비용의 일부에 불과하지만, 단 하나의 입력재 부족으로도 생산 라인이 멈출 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That is why technology companies are mapping their suppliers more deeply, qualifying second sources and holding larger inventories of key materials than they did a decade ago.
segments.tr: 이것이 기술 기업들이 10년 전보다 공급업체를 더 깊이 파악하고, 제2의 공급처를 검증하며, 주요 원자재의 재고를 더 많이 보유하는 이유입니다.

segments.src: ## The trade-offs: environment, cost and community
segments.tr: ## 절충점: 환경, 비용 및 지역사회

segments.src: Expanding mining and processing is not a simple fix.
segments.tr: 채굴과 가공을 늘리는 것은 간단한 해결책이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Mining can affect water, land and local communities, and rare earth processing involves chemicals and sometimes low-level radioactive byproducts that must be managed responsibly.
segments.tr: 채굴은 수질, 토지 및 지역사회에 영향을 미칠 수 있으며, 희토류 가공에는 화학 물질과 때로는 책임감 있게 관리해야 하는 저준위 방사성 부산물이 수반됩니다.

segments.src: Labor and safety conditions in some regions, including artisanal cobalt mining, have drawn scrutiny.
segments.tr: 영세 코발트 채굴을 포함한 일부 지역의 노동 및 안전 조건은 조사를 받아왔습니다.

segments.src: Many buyers now ask for traceability and responsible-sourcing standards, which can raise costs but also reduce reputational and regulatory risk.
segments.tr: 많은 구매자들은 이제 추적 가능성과 책임 있는 조달 기준을 요구하며, 이는 비용을 상승시킬 수 있지만 평판 및 규제 위험도 줄여줍니다.

segments.src: There is also a cost question.
segments.tr: 비용 문제도 존재합니다.

segments.src: Production in new locations may be more expensive than in established hubs, and some projects depend on subsidies, price floors or guaranteed purchases to be viable.
segments.tr: 새로운 지역에서의 생산은 기존 거점보다 비용이 더 많이 들 수 있으며, 일부 프로젝트는 생존 가능성을 갖추기 위해 보조금, 가격 하한선 또는 보장된 구매에 의존합니다.

segments.src: How much consumers and taxpayers are willing to pay for supply security is an ongoing policy debate.
segments.tr: 공급 안보를 위해 소비자와 납세자가 얼마나 지불할 용의가 있는지는 지속적인 정책 논쟁거리입니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## 주시해야 할 사항

segments.src: - **Policy announcements:** New export rules, licensing changes and trade agreements can shift supply expectations quickly.
segments.tr: - **정책 발표:** 새로운 수출 규정, 라이선스 변경 및 무역 협정은 공급 예상을 빠르게 변화시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Project milestones:** Whether announced mines and refineries actually reach production on schedule.
segments.tr: - **프로젝트 마일스톤:** 발표된 광산과 정련소가 실제로 일정에 맞춰 생산에 도달하는지 여부.

segments.src: - **Recycling rates and technology shifts:** Progress in battery recycling and in magnet designs that use less of the scarcest materials.
segments.tr: - **재활용률 및 기술 변화:** 배터리 재활용과 가장 희소한 원자재를 덜 사용하는 자석 설계의 진전.

segments.src: - **Price signals:** Sustained moves in rare earth, lithium, cobalt or graphite prices often reflect changes in supply risk or demand.
segments.tr: - **가격 신호:** 희토류, 리튬, 코발트 또는 흑연 가격의 지속적인 움직임은 흔히 공급 위험이나 수요의 변화를 반영합니다.

segments.src: - **Public and private stockpile plans:** Funding decisions and purchasing programs that indicate how seriously governments view the risk.
segments.tr: - **공공 및 민간 비축 계획:** 정부가 이 위험을 얼마나 심각하게 보는지 나타내는 자금 조달 결정 및 구매 프로그램.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 핵심 요약

segments.src: Critical minerals are small in volume compared with oil or steel, but their influence on modern industry is outsized.
segments.tr: 핵심 광물은 석유나 철강에 비해 부피는 작지만, 현대 산업에 미치는 영향력은 막대합니다.

segments.src: The same few materials link the car in your driveway, the phone in your pocket and the equipment that defends a country.
segments.tr: 동일한 소수의 원자재가 귀하의 진입로에 있는 자동차, 주머니 속의 전화기, 국방 장비를 연결합니다.

segments.src: Because their supply is concentrated, they have become a lever in trade policy and a focus of national planning.
segments.tr: 공급이 집중되어 있기 때문에 무역 정책의 지렛대이자 국가 계획의 핵심 과제가 되었습니다.

segments.src: Diversifying that supply will take years, and the path will involve difficult choices about cost, environmental impact and international cooperation.
segments.tr: 그 공급을 다변화하는 데는 수년이 걸릴 것이며, 그 과정에는 비용, 환경 영향 및 국제 협력에 대한 어려운 선택이 수반될 것입니다.

segments.tr: *본 문서는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적으로만 제공되며 투자, 금융 또는 정책 조언을 구성하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Market conditions and government policies change frequently; please consult official sources for the latest information.*
segments.tr: 시장 상황과 정부 정책은 자주 변경되므로 최신 정보는 공식 출처를 확인하시기 바랍니다.*

zh.title: 机器背后的金属：为什么稀土和关键矿产成为地缘政治焦点

segments.src: Every electric car, wind turbine, smartphone and guided missile contains materials most people never think about.
segments.tr: 每一辆电动汽车、风力发电机、智能手机和制导导弹，都包含着大多数人从未思考过的材料。

segments.src: Rare earth elements, lithium, cobalt, graphite, gallium and a handful of other critical minerals sit deep inside modern supply chains.
segments.tr: 稀土元素、锂、钴、石墨、镓以及少数其他关键矿产，深藏于现代供应链的底层。

segments.src: Because production and processing of many of them are concentrated in just a few countries, they have become a recurring point of tension in trade policy and national security planning.
segments.tr: 由于其中许多矿产的生产和加工高度集中在少数几个国家，它们已成为贸易政策和国家安全规划中反复出现的紧张焦点。

segments.src: ## What are "critical minerals" and rare earths?
segments.tr: ## 什么是“关键矿产”和稀土？

segments.src: "Critical minerals" is a policy label, not a scientific category.
segments.tr: “关键矿产”是一个政策标签，而不是一个科学分类。

segments.src: Governments, including the United States, the European Union, Japan and Australia, maintain lists of materials that are both important to their economies and vulnerable to supply disruption.
segments.tr: 包括美国、欧盟、日本和澳大利亚在内的各国政府，都制定了对本国经济至关重要且容易遭受供应中断的材料清单。

segments.src: The lists differ, but they commonly include lithium, cobalt, nickel, graphite, manganese, gallium, germanium and the group known as rare earth elements.
segments.tr: 这些清单各有不同，但通常都包括锂、钴、镍、石墨、锰、镓、锗以及被称为稀土元素的群体。

segments.src: Despite the name, rare earths are not especially scarce in the Earth's crust.
segments.tr: 尽管名称中有“稀”字，稀土在地壳中的含量其实并不算稀少。

segments.src: The challenge is that they are rarely found in concentrations that are easy and economical to mine, and separating them from one another is a complex, chemically intensive process that can generate significant waste.
segments.tr: 挑战在于，它们极少以易于且具备经济效益的方式成矿开采，而且将它们彼此分离是一个极其复杂、需大量化学处理的过程，可能会产生大量废弃物。

segments.src: ## Where they show up in everyday products
segments.tr: ## 它们出现在日常用品的哪些地方

segments.src: - **Magnets:** Neodymium and praseodymium are used in high-strength permanent magnets. These appear in electric vehicle motors, wind turbine generators, hard drives, headphones and many industrial robots. Dysprosium and terbium are added to help magnets withstand heat.
segments.tr: - **磁体：** 钕和镨用于制造高强度永磁体。这些磁体广泛应用于电动汽车电机、风力发电机、硬盘、耳机以及许多工业机器人中。镝和铽的加入则有助于磁体耐受高温。

segments.src: - **Batteries:** Lithium, nickel, cobalt, manganese and graphite are central to most lithium-ion batteries, which power vehicles, laptops, phones and grid storage systems.
segments.tr: - **电池：** 锂、镍、钴、锰和石墨是大多数锂离子电池的核心材料，这些电池为车辆、笔记本电脑、手机和电网储能系统提供动力。

segments.src: - **Chips and electronics:** Gallium and germanium are used in certain semiconductors, power electronics, fiber optics and infrared sensors. Many other specialty metals play smaller but essential roles in manufacturing.
segments.tr: - **芯片与电子产品：** 镓和锗用于某些半导体、功率电子设备、光纤和红外传感器中。许多其他特种金属也在制造过程中发挥着微小但至关重要的作用。

segments.src: - **Defense systems:** Radar, sonar, precision guidance, jet engines and communications equipment rely on specialty magnets and alloys.
segments.tr: - **国防系统：** 雷达、声纳、精准制导、喷气式发动机和通信设备都依赖于特种磁体和合金。

segments.src: ## Why concentration matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么集中度如此重要

segments.src: The key issue is not only who mines these materials, but who refines them.
segments.tr: 关键问题不仅在于谁开采了这些材料，还在于谁提炼了它们。

segments.src: Mining may be spread across several countries, yet a large share of processing capacity for many minerals, especially rare earth separation and magnet manufacturing, has been concentrated in China, according to analyses from the International Energy Agency and other agencies.
segments.tr: 根据国际能源署和其他机构的分析，开采可能分布在多个国家，但许多矿产的大部分加工产能——特别是稀土分离和磁体制造——一直集中在中国。

segments.src: Other pieces of the chain are concentrated elsewhere: the Democratic Republic of the Congo supplies a large portion of the world's cobalt, and Indonesia has become the leading nickel producer.
segments.tr: 供应链的其他环节则集中在其他地方：刚果民主共和国供应了全球很大一部分的钴，而印度尼西亚已成为领先的镍生产国。

segments.src: When so much of a supply chain depends on a small number of countries or facilities, any disruption can ripple outward.
segments.tr: 当一条供应链如此高度依赖少数国家或设施时，任何中断都可能产生连锁反应。

segments.src: That disruption might come from a trade dispute, a policy change, a natural disaster, a labor problem or a political conflict.
segments.tr: 这种中断可能源于贸易争端、政策改变、自然灾害、劳工问题或政治冲突。

segments.src: Even the possibility of disruption can push companies and governments to rethink how they source materials.
segments.tr: 甚至仅仅是供应中断的可能性，就能促使企业和政府重新审视其材料采购方式。

segments.src: ## Export controls: a policy tool with consequences
segments.tr: ## 出口管制：一种带有连锁后果的政策工具

segments.src: Export controls restrict or require licenses for shipments of certain goods or technologies.
segments.tr: 出口管制对某些货物或技术的出货施加限制或要求申请许可证。

segments.src: In recent years, several countries have introduced or expanded controls on minerals and related processing technology.
segments.tr: 近年来，多个国家出台或扩大了对矿产及相关加工技术的管控。

segments.src: China, for example, has applied licensing requirements to exports of gallium, germanium, graphite and some rare earth products and magnets.
segments.tr: 例如，中国对镓、锗、石墨以及部分稀土产品和磁体的出口实施了许可要求。

segments.src: Other governments have used their own controls on advanced chips and manufacturing equipment, which in turn has shaped the broader trade debate.
segments.tr: 其他政府也对先进芯片和制造设备实施了自身的管制，这反过来塑造了更广泛的贸易议题。

segments.src: Officials who impose such rules typically cite national security, environmental protection or compliance with international obligations.
segments.tr: 出台此类规则的官员通常会引用国家安全、环境保护或遵守国际义务作为依据。

segments.src: Importing countries and manufacturers often view them as a source of uncertainty.
segments.tr: 进口国和制造商往往将这些规则视为不确定性的来源。

segments.src: Whatever the motive, the practical effect is that buyers may face longer lead times, paperwork, higher prices or a need to find alternative suppliers.
segments.tr: 无论动机如何，实际效果是买方可能会面临更长的交货周期、繁琐的手续、更高的价格，或是寻找替代供应商的需求。

segments.src: The details of these measures change over time, so readers following the topic should check current government announcements.
segments.tr: 这些措施的细节会随时间而变化，因此关注该主题的读者应查阅政府的最新公告。

segments.src: ## Stockpiling and strategic reserves
segments.tr: ## 战略储备与囤积

segments.src: Stockpiling is an old idea that is getting new attention.
segments.tr: 囤积是一个古老的概念，如今再次受到关注。

segments.src: Japan has long maintained reserves of rare metals through a government-backed agency.
segments.tr: 日本长期以来通过政府背景的机构保持着稀有金属的储备。

segments.src: The United States keeps a National Defense Stockpile, and the European Union has discussed building strategic reserves and coordinating purchases.
segments.tr: 美国维持着国防储备，而欧盟也讨论了建立战略储备和协调采购事宜。

segments.src: Several governments have also considered or launched programs to fund domestic inventories of the materials most important to defense and clean energy.
segments.tr: 一些国家政府还考虑或启动了相关计划，资助对国防和清洁能源最重要的材料的国内库存。

segments.src: Stockpiles can cushion short-term shocks, but they have limits.
segments.tr: 储备可以缓冲短期冲击，但也有其局限性。

segments.src: Storing materials costs money, some products degrade or become outdated, and a reserve cannot replace a long-term supply chain.
segments.tr: 储存材料需要资金，某些产品会变质或过时，而且储备无法取代长期的供应链。

segments.src: Analysts generally describe stockpiles as one tool among several rather than a complete solution.
segments.tr: 分析人士普遍将储备描述为众多工具中的一种，而非万能解决方案。

segments.src: ## New mining deals and the race to diversify
segments.tr: ## 新开采协议与多元化竞赛

segments.src: Governments and companies are pursuing partnerships to broaden supply.
segments.tr: 政府和企业正在寻求合作，以拓宽供应渠道。

segments.src: Examples of the trend include:
segments.tr: 这一趋势的例子包括：

segments.src: - **Government agreements:** The United States, the EU, Japan, Australia, Canada and others have signed memoranda and frameworks on critical minerals cooperation, sometimes alongside financing and shared standards.
segments.tr: - **政府间协议：** 美国、欧盟、日本、澳大利亚、加拿大等已签署了关于关键矿产合作的谅解备忘录和框架协议，有时还伴随着资金支持和共同标准。

segments.src: - **Investment in new projects:** Mines and processing plants are being developed or expanded in Australia, Canada, the United States, parts of Africa and Latin America, and elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **新项目投资：** 澳大利亚、加拿大、美国、非洲部分地区、拉丁美洲以及其他地方的矿山和加工厂正在建设或扩建中。

segments.src: - **Offtake agreements and public financing:** Automakers and manufacturers have signed long-term purchase contracts, while public lenders and development banks have backed projects that private markets might consider too risky.
segments.tr: - **包销协议与公共融资：** 车企和制造商签署了长期采购合同，同时公共贷款机构和开发银行对私营市场可能认为风险过高的项目提供了支持。

segments.src: - **Recycling and substitution:** Companies are working on recovering metals from used batteries and magnets, and engineers are designing motors and batteries that use fewer constrained materials.
segments.tr: - **回收与替代：** 企业正在致力于从废旧电池和磁体中回收金属，工程师们也在设计减少使用受限材料的电机和电池。

segments.src: Building a new mine or refinery is slow.
segments.tr: 新建矿山或炼厂进展缓慢。

segments.src: It can take a decade or more to move from discovery to production, with permitting, financing, community consultation and environmental review along the way.
segments.tr: 从勘探到投产可能需要十年或更长时间，期间要经历许可、融资、社区咨询和环境审查等诸多环节。

segments.src: That timeline means diversification is a long-term effort, and near-term supply can remain tight even when new projects are announced.
segments.tr: 这一时间表意味着多元化是一项长期努力，即使宣布了新项目，近期的供应依然可能趋紧。

segments.src: ## How this reaches car prices
segments.tr: ## 这如何波及汽车价格

segments.src: Battery packs represent a large share of the cost of an electric vehicle, and magnet-equipped motors are used in most of them.
segments.tr: 电池组占电动汽车成本的很大一部分，而大多数电动汽车都使用配置磁体的电机。

segments.src: Gasoline and hybrid vehicles use these materials too, in sensors, motors, speakers and power steering systems.
segments.tr: 汽油车和混合动力汽车也同样在传感器、电机、扬声器和动力转向系统中采用这些材料。

segments.src: When mineral prices rise or supply tightens, manufacturers may absorb some of the cost, pass it on to buyers, redesign components or slow production.
segments.tr: 当矿产价格上涨或供应趋紧时，制造商可能会自行消化部分成本、将其转嫁给买方、重新设计零部件或放缓生产。

segments.src: Price swings have been notable in recent years.
segments.tr: 近年来的价格波动尤为显著。

segments.src: Lithium prices, for instance, rose sharply during the early 2020s and then fell significantly as new supply arrived, illustrating how volatile these markets can be.
segments.tr: 例如，锂价格在 2020 年代初期大幅上涨，随后随着新供应的到位而大幅下跌，这展现了这些市场的波动性。

segments.src: For consumers, the effect is usually indirect and delayed, showing up in vehicle pricing, available options or waiting times rather than as a line item on a sticker.
segments.tr: 对消费者而言，其影响通常是间接且滞后的，体现为车辆定价、可选配置或等待时间的变化，而不是车窗贴纸上的单项明细。

segments.src: ## Why defense planners care
segments.tr: ## 国防规划者为何关注

segments.src: Modern military equipment depends on high-performance magnets, specialty alloys and electronic components.
segments.tr: 现代军事装备依赖高性能磁体、特种合金和电子元件。

segments.src: Defense officials in several countries have flagged that relying on a limited set of foreign suppliers for these inputs is a vulnerability.
segments.tr: 多个国家的国防官员已提出警示，在这些投入品上依赖有限的外国供应商是一种隐患。

segments.src: This is one reason that mineral policy has moved from the trade desk to national security discussions, and why some defense budgets now include support for domestic processing and magnet production.
segments.tr: 这也是矿产政策从贸易部门转向国家安全讨论的原因之一，也是为什么某些国防预算现在包含对国内加工和磁体生产支持的原因。

segments.src: ## Tech supply chains and the semiconductor connection
segments.tr: ## 科技供应链与半导体关联

segments.src: Chipmaking is a global relay race involving design, materials, equipment, fabrication and packaging across many countries.
segments.tr: 芯片制造是一场跨越多个国家，包含设计、材料、设备、制造和封装的全球接力赛。

segments.src: Specialty metals and gases form only a small part of the finished product's cost, but a shortage of a single input can halt a production line.
segments.tr: 特种金属和气体仅占成品成本的一小部分，但单一投入品的短缺就可能使整条生产线停工。

segments.src: That is why technology companies are mapping their suppliers more deeply, qualifying second sources and holding larger inventories of key materials than they did a decade ago.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么科技公司比十年前更深入地梳理其供应商，认证备用来源，并持有更多关键材料库存的原因。

segments.src: ## The trade-offs: environment, cost and community
segments.tr: ## 权衡：环境、成本与社区

segments.src: Expanding mining and processing is not a simple fix.
segments.tr: 扩大采矿和加工绝非简单之举。

segments.src: Mining can affect water, land and local communities, and rare earth processing involves chemicals and sometimes low-level radioactive byproducts that must be managed responsibly.
segments.tr: 采矿会影响水资源、土地和当地社区，而稀土加工涉及化学品，有时还会产生必须受到妥善管理的低放射性副产品。

segments.src: Labor and safety conditions in some regions, including artisanal cobalt mining, have drawn scrutiny.
segments.tr: 某些地区（包括手工钴矿开采）的劳工和安全条件受到了审查。

segments.src: Many buyers now ask for traceability and responsible-sourcing standards, which can raise costs but also reduce reputational and regulatory risk.
segments.tr: 如今，许多买方要求具备可追溯性和负责任采购的标准，这可能会推高成本，但也能降低声誉和监管风险。

segments.src: There is also a cost question.
segments.tr: 此外还有成本问题。

segments.src: Production in new locations may be more expensive than in established hubs, and some projects depend on subsidies, price floors or guaranteed purchases to be viable.
segments.tr: 在新地点的生产可能比在成熟枢纽的成本更高，有些项目需要依赖补贴、最低价格保障或保底采购才能维持生存。

segments.src: How much consumers and taxpayers are willing to pay for supply security is an ongoing policy debate.
segments.tr: 消费者和纳税人愿意为供应安全支付多少代价，是一项持续进行的政策讨论。

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## 值得关注的方面

segments.src: - **Policy announcements:** New export rules, licensing changes and trade agreements can shift supply expectations quickly.
segments.tr: - **政策公告：** 新的出口规则、许可变更和贸易协定可以迅速改变供应预期。

segments.src: - **Project milestones:** Whether announced mines and refineries actually reach production on schedule.
segments.tr: - **项目里程碑：** 已公布的矿山和炼厂是否能按计划投产。

segments.src: - **Recycling rates and technology shifts:** Progress in battery recycling and in magnet designs that use less of the scarcest materials.
segments.tr: - **回收率与技术演变：** 电池回收以及使用更少稀缺材料的磁体设计方面的进展。

segments.src: - **Price signals:** Sustained moves in rare earth, lithium, cobalt or graphite prices often reflect changes in supply risk or demand.
segments.tr: - **价格信号：** 稀土、锂、钴或石墨价格的持续走势往往反映了供应风险或需求的变化。

segments.src: - **Public and private stockpile plans:** Funding decisions and purchasing programs that indicate how seriously governments view the risk.
segments.tr: - **公共和私营储备计划：** 表明政府对风险重视程度的资金决策和采购计划。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: Critical minerals are small in volume compared with oil or steel, but their influence on modern industry is outsized.
segments.tr: 与石油或钢铁相比，关键矿产的数量较少，但它们对现代工业的影响力却极其巨大。

segments.src: The same few materials link the car in your driveway, the phone in your pocket and the equipment that defends a country.
segments.tr: 同一种材料，将你车道上的汽车、口袋里的手机以及保卫国家的装备联系在了一起。

segments.src: Because their supply is concentrated, they have become a lever in trade policy and a focus of national planning.
segments.tr: 由于它们的供应高度集中，它们已成为贸易政策的筹码和国家规划的焦点。

segments.src: Diversifying that supply will take years, and the path will involve difficult choices about cost, environmental impact and international cooperation.
segments.tr: 实现供应多元化需要多年时间，而这一过程将涉及关于成本、环境影响和国际合作的艰难选择。

hi.title: मशीनों के पीछे की धातुएं: दुर्लभ पृथ्वी और महत्वपूर्ण खनिज एक भू-राजनीतिक दबाव बिंदु क्यों हैं

segments.src: Every electric car, wind turbine, smartphone and guided missile contains materials most people never think about.
segments.tr: हर इलेक्ट्रिक कार, विंड टर्बाइन, स्मार्टफोन और गाइडेड मिसाइल में ऐसी सामग्रियां होती हैं जिनके बारे में ज्यादातर लोग कभी नहीं सोचते।

segments.src: Rare earth elements, lithium, cobalt, graphite, gallium and a handful of other critical minerals sit deep inside modern supply chains.
segments.tr: दुर्लभ पृथ्वी तत्व, लिथियम, कोबाल्ट, ग्रेफाइट, गैलियम और कुछ अन्य महत्वपूर्ण खनिज आधुनिक आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाओं के बहुत अंदर तक स्थित हैं।

segments.src: Because production and processing of many of them are concentrated in just a few countries, they have become a recurring point of tension in trade policy and national security planning.
segments.tr: चूंकि इनमें से कई का उत्पादन और प्रसंस्करण केवल कुछ ही देशों में केंद्रित है, इसलिए वे व्यापार नीति और राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा योजना में तनाव का एक आवर्ती बिंदु बन गए हैं।

segments.src: ## What are "critical minerals" and rare earths?
segments.tr: ## "महत्वपूर्ण खनिज" और दुर्लभ पृथ्वी क्या हैं?

segments.src: "Critical minerals" is a policy label, not a scientific category.
segments.tr: "महत्वपूर्ण खनिज" एक नीतिगत लेबल है, न कि कोई वैज्ञानिक श्रेणी।

segments.src: Governments, including the United States, the European Union, Japan and Australia, maintain lists of materials that are both important to their economies and vulnerable to supply disruption.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राष्ट्र, यूरोपीय संघ, जापान और ऑस्ट्रेलिया सहित सरकारें उन सामग्रियों की सूची बनाए रखती हैं जो उनकी अर्थव्यवस्थाओं के लिए महत्वपूर्ण हैं और आपूर्ति व्यवधान के प्रति संवेदनशील हैं।

segments.src: The lists differ, but they commonly include lithium, cobalt, nickel, graphite, manganese, gallium, germanium and the group known as rare earth elements.
segments.tr: सूचियां अलग-अलग हैं, लेकिन उनमें आमतौर पर लिथियम, कोबाल्ट, निकेल, ग्रेफाइट, मैंगनीज, गैलियम, जर्मेनियम और दुर्लभ पृथ्वी तत्वों के रूप में जाने जाने वाले समूह शामिल हैं।

segments.src: Despite the name, rare earths are not especially scarce in the Earth's crust.
segments.tr: नाम के विपरीत, दुर्लभ पृथ्वी पृथ्वी की पपड़ी में विशेष रूप से दुर्लभ नहीं हैं।

segments.src: The challenge is that they are rarely found in concentrations that are easy and economical to mine, and separating them from one another is a complex, chemically intensive process that can generate significant waste.
segments.tr: चुनौती यह है कि वे शायद ही कभी ऐसे सांद्रण में पाए जाते हैं जिनका खनन करना आसान और किफायती हो, और उन्हें एक दूसरे से अलग करना एक जटिल, रासायनिक रूप से गहन प्रक्रिया है जो महत्वपूर्ण कचरा उत्पन्न कर सकती है।

segments.src: ## Where they show up in everyday products
segments.tr: ## वे रोजमर्रा के उत्पादों में कहां दिखाई देते हैं

segments.src: - **Magnets:** Neodymium and praseodymium are used in high-strength permanent magnets. These appear in electric vehicle motors, wind turbine generators, hard drives, headphones and many industrial robots. Dysprosium and terbium are added to help magnets withstand heat.
segments.tr: - **Magnets:** नियोडिमियम और प्रेसिडिमियम का उपयोग उच्च शक्ति वाले स्थायी चुम्बकों में किया जाता है। ये इलेक्ट्रिक वाहन मोटर्स, विंड टर्बाइन जनरेटर, हार्ड ड्राइव, हेडफ़ोन और कई औद्योगिक रोबोट में दिखाई देते हैं। चुम्बकों को गर्मी का सामना करने में मदद करने के लिए डिस्प्रोसियम और टर्बियम मिलाए जाते हैं।

segments.src: - **Batteries:** Lithium, nickel, cobalt, manganese and graphite are central to most lithium-ion batteries, which power vehicles, laptops, phones and grid storage systems.
segments.tr: - **Batteries:** लिथियम, निकेल, कोबाल्ट, मैंगनीज और ग्रेफाइट अधिकांश लिथियम-आयन बैटरी के केंद्र में हैं, जो वाहनों, लैपटॉप, फोन और ग्रिड स्टोरेज सिस्टम को शक्ति प्रदान करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Chips and electronics:** Gallium and germanium are used in certain semiconductors, power electronics, fiber optics and infrared sensors. Many other specialty metals play smaller but essential roles in manufacturing.
segments.tr: - **Chips and electronics:** गैलियम और जर्मेनियम का उपयोग कुछ अर्धचालकों, पावर इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स, फाइबर ऑप्टिक्स और इन्फ्रारेड सेंसर में किया जाता है। कई अन्य विशेष धातुएं निर्माण में छोटे लेकिन आवश्यक भूमिका निभाती हैं।

segments.src: - **Defense systems:** Radar, sonar, precision guidance, jet engines and communications equipment rely on specialty magnets and alloys.
segments.tr: - **Defense systems:** रडार, सोनार, सटीक मार्गदर्शन, जेट इंजन और संचार उपकरण विशेष चुम्बकों और मिश्र धातुओं पर भरोसा करते हैं।

segments.src: ## Why concentration matters
segments.tr: ## सांद्रण क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: The key issue is not only who mines these materials, but who refines them.
segments.tr: मुख्य मुद्दा यह नहीं है कि इन सामग्रियों का खनन कौन करता है, बल्कि यह है कि इन्हें कौन परिष्कृत करता है।

segments.src: Mining may be spread across several countries, yet a large share of processing capacity for many minerals, especially rare earth separation and magnet manufacturing, has been concentrated in China, according to analyses from the International Energy Agency and other agencies.
segments.tr: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय ऊर्जा एजेंसी और अन्य एजेंसियों के विश्लेषण के अनुसार, खनन कई देशों में फैला हो सकता है, फिर भी कई खनिजों के लिए प्रसंस्करण क्षमता का एक बड़ा हिस्सा, विशेष रूप से दुर्लभ पृथ्वी पृथक्करण और चुंबक विनिर्माण, चीन में केंद्रित रहा है।

segments.src: Other pieces of the chain are concentrated elsewhere: the Democratic Republic of the Congo supplies a large portion of the world's cobalt, and Indonesia has become the leading nickel producer.
segments.tr: श्रृंखला के अन्य टुकड़े कहीं और केंद्रित हैं: कांगो लोकतांत्रिक गणराज्य दुनिया के कोबाल्ट का एक बड़ा हिस्सा आपूर्ति करता है, और इंडोनेशिया अग्रणी निकेल उत्पादक बन गया है।

segments.src: When so much of a supply chain depends on a small number of countries or facilities, any disruption can ripple outward.
segments.tr: जब आपूर्ति श्रृंखला का इतना हिस्सा कुछ ही देशों या सुविधाओं पर निर्भर करता है, तो कोई भी व्यवधान बाहर की ओर फैल सकता है।

segments.src: That disruption might come from a trade dispute, a policy change, a natural disaster, a labor problem or a political conflict.
segments.tr: वह व्यवधान किसी व्यापार विवाद, नीतिगत बदलाव, प्राकृतिक आपदा, श्रम समस्या या राजनीतिक संघर्ष से आ सकता है।

segments.src: Even the possibility of disruption can push companies and governments to rethink how they source materials.
segments.tr: व्यवधान की संभावना भी कंपनियों और सरकारों को यह पुनर्विचार करने के लिए प्रेरित कर सकती है कि वे सामग्री कैसे प्राप्त करते हैं।

segments.src: ## Export controls: a policy tool with consequences
segments.tr: ## निर्यात नियंत्रण: परिणामों के साथ एक नीति उपकरण

segments.src: Export controls restrict or require licenses for shipments of certain goods or technologies.
segments.tr: निर्यात नियंत्रण कुछ वस्तुओं या प्रौद्योगिकियों के शिपमेंट को प्रतिबंधित करते हैं या उनके लिए लाइसेंस की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: In recent years, several countries have introduced or expanded controls on minerals and related processing technology.
segments.tr: हाल के वर्षों में, कई देशों ने खनिजों और संबंधित प्रसंस्करण तकनीक पर नियंत्रण पेश या विस्तारित किया है।

segments.src: China, for example, has applied licensing requirements to exports of gallium, germanium, graphite and some rare earth products and magnets.
segments.tr: उदाहरण के लिए, चीन ने गैलियम, जर्मेनियम, ग्रेफाइट और कुछ दुर्लभ पृथ्वी उत्पादों और चुम्बकों के निर्यात पर लाइसेंसिंग आवश्यकताएं लागू की हैं।

segments.src: Other governments have used their own controls on advanced chips and manufacturing equipment, which in turn has shaped the broader trade debate.
segments.tr: अन्य सरकारों ने उन्नत चिप्स और विनिर्माण उपकरणों पर अपने स्वयं के नियंत्रण का उपयोग किया है, जिसने बदले में व्यापक व्यापार बहस को आकार दिया है।

segments.src: Officials who impose such rules typically cite national security, environmental protection or compliance with international obligations.
segments.tr: ऐसे नियम लगाने वाले अधिकारी आम तौर पर राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा, पर्यावरण संरक्षण या अंतरराष्ट्रीय दायित्वों के अनुपालन का हवाला देते हैं।

segments.src: Importing countries and manufacturers often view them as a source of uncertainty.
segments.tr: आयात करने वाले देश और निर्माता अक्सर उन्हें अनिश्चितता के स्रोत के रूप में देखते हैं।

segments.src: Whatever the motive, the practical effect is that buyers may face longer lead times, paperwork, higher prices or a need to find alternative suppliers.
segments.tr: प्रेरणा चाहे जो भी हो, व्यावहारिक प्रभाव यह है कि खरीदारों को लंबे लीड समय, कागजी कार्रवाई, उच्च कीमतों या वैकल्पिक आपूर्तिकर्ताओं को खोजने की आवश्यकता का सामना करना पड़ सकता है।

segments.src: The details of these measures change over time, so readers following the topic should check current government announcements.
segments.tr: इन उपायों का विवरण समय के साथ बदलता रहता है, इसलिए इस विषय का अनुसरण करने वाले पाठकों को वर्तमान सरकारी घोषणाओं की जांच करनी चाहिए।

segments.src: ## Stockpiling and strategic reserves
segments.tr: ## स्टॉकपिलिंग और रणनीतिक भंडार

segments.src: Stockpiling is an old idea that is getting new attention.
segments.tr: स्टॉकपिलिंग एक पुराना विचार है जिस पर नया ध्यान मिल रहा है।

segments.src: Japan has long maintained reserves of rare metals through a government-backed agency.
segments.tr: जापान ने लंबे समय से एक सरकार समर्थित एजेंसी के माध्यम से दुर्लभ धातुओं के भंडार बनाए रखे हैं।

segments.src: The United States keeps a National Defense Stockpile, and the European Union has discussed building strategic reserves and coordinating purchases.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका राष्ट्रीय रक्षा स्टॉकपाइल रखता है, और यूरोपीय संघ ने रणनीतिक भंडार बनाने और खरीद का समन्वय करने पर चर्चा की है।

segments.src: Several governments have also considered or launched programs to fund domestic inventories of the materials most important to defense and clean energy.
segments.tr: कई सरकारों ने रक्षा और स्वच्छ ऊर्जा के लिए सबसे महत्वपूर्ण सामग्रियों की घरेलू इन्वेंट्री को निधि देने के लिए कार्यक्रमों पर विचार किया है या उन्हें शुरू किया है।

segments.src: Stockpiles can cushion short-term shocks, but they have limits.
segments.tr: स्टॉकपाइल अल्पकालिक झटकों को कुशन कर सकते हैं, लेकिन उनकी सीमाएं हैं।

segments.src: Storing materials costs money, some products degrade or become outdated, and a reserve cannot replace a long-term supply chain.
segments.tr: सामग्री के भंडारण में पैसा खर्च होता है, कुछ उत्पाद खराब हो जाते हैं या पुराने हो जाते हैं, और एक रिजर्व दीर्घकालिक आपूर्ति श्रृंखला की जगह नहीं ले सकता है।

segments.src: Analysts generally describe stockpiles as one tool among several rather than a complete solution.
segments.tr: विश्लेषक आम तौर पर स्टॉकपाइल को पूर्ण समाधान के बजाय कई उपकरणों में से एक के रूप में वर्णित करते हैं।

segments.src: ## New mining deals and the race to diversify
segments.tr: ## नए खनन सौदे और विविधता लाने की दौड़

segments.src: Governments and companies are pursuing partnerships to broaden supply.
segments.tr: सरकारें और कंपनियां आपूर्ति को व्यापक बनाने के लिए साझेदारी कर रही हैं।

segments.src: Examples of the trend include:
segments.tr: प्रवृत्ति के उदाहरणों में शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - **Government agreements:** The United States, the EU, Japan, Australia, Canada and others have signed memoranda and frameworks on critical minerals cooperation, sometimes alongside financing and shared standards.
segments.tr: - **Government agreements:** संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका, यूरोपीय संघ, जापान, ऑस्ट्रेलिया, कनाडा और अन्य ने महत्वपूर्ण खनिजों के सहयोग पर ज्ञापनों और रूपरेखाओं पर हस्ताक्षर किए हैं, कभी-कभी वित्तपोषण और साझा मानकों के साथ।

segments.src: - **Investment in new projects:** Mines and processing plants are being developed or expanded in Australia, Canada, the United States, parts of Africa and Latin America, and elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Investment in new projects:** ऑस्ट्रेलिया, कनाडा, संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका, अफ्रीका और लैटिन अमेरिका के कुछ हिस्सों और अन्य जगहों पर खानों और प्रसंस्करण संयंत्रों को विकसित या विस्तारित किया जा रहा है।

segments.src: - **Offtake agreements and public financing:** Automakers and manufacturers have signed long-term purchase contracts, while public lenders and development banks have backed projects that private markets might consider too risky.
segments.tr: - **Offtake agreements and public financing:** वाहन निर्माताओं और निर्माताओं ने दीर्घकालिक खरीद अनुबंधों पर हस्ताक्षर किए हैं, जबकि सार्वजनिक ऋणदाताओं और विकास बैंकों ने उन परियोजनाओं का समर्थन किया है जिन्हें निजी बाजार बहुत जोखिम भरा मान सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Recycling and substitution:** Companies are working on recovering metals from used batteries and magnets, and engineers are designing motors and batteries that use fewer constrained materials.
segments.tr: - **Recycling and substitution:** कंपनियां इस्तेमाल की गई बैटरियों और चुम्बकों से धातुओं को पुनर्प्राप्त करने पर काम कर रही हैं, और इंजीनियर ऐसे मोटर और बैटरी डिजाइन कर रहे हैं जो कम प्रतिबंधित सामग्रियों का उपयोग करते हैं।

segments.src: Building a new mine or refinery is slow.
segments.tr: एक नई खदान या रिफाइनरी का निर्माण धीमा होता है।

segments.src: It can take a decade or more to move from discovery to production, with permitting, financing, community consultation and environmental review along the way.
segments.tr: खोज से लेकर उत्पादन तक जाने में एक दशक या उससे अधिक का समय लग सकता है, जिसमें रास्ते में अनुमति, वित्तपोषण, सामुदायिक परामर्श और पर्यावरण समीक्षा शामिल है।

segments.src: That timeline means diversification is a long-term effort, and near-term supply can remain tight even when new projects are announced.
segments.tr: उस समयसीमा का मतलब है कि विविधीकरण एक दीर्घकालिक प्रयास है, और नई परियोजनाओं की घोषणा होने पर भी अल्पकालिक आपूर्ति तंग बनी रह सकती है।

segments.src: ## How this reaches car prices
segments.tr: ## यह कार की कीमतों तक कैसे पहुंचता है

segments.src: Battery packs represent a large share of the cost of an electric vehicle, and magnet-equipped motors are used in most of them.
segments.tr: बैटरी पैक इलेक्ट्रिक वाहन की लागत का एक बड़ा हिस्सा प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं, और उनमें से अधिकांश में चुंबक-सुसज्जित मोटर्स का उपयोग किया जाता है।

segments.src: Gasoline and hybrid vehicles use these materials too, in sensors, motors, speakers and power steering systems.
segments.tr: गैसोलीन और हाइब्रिड वाहन भी इन सामग्रियों का उपयोग सेंसर, मोटर्स, स्पीकर और पावर स्टीयरिंग सिस्टम में करते हैं।

segments.src: When mineral prices rise or supply tightens, manufacturers may absorb some of the cost, pass it on to buyers, redesign components or slow production.
segments.tr: जब खनिज की कीमतें बढ़ती हैं या आपूर्ति तंग होती है, तो निर्माता लागत का कुछ हिस्सा अवशोषित कर सकते हैं, इसे खरीदारों को पास कर सकते हैं, घटकों को फिर से डिजाइन कर सकते हैं या उत्पादन धीमा कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Price swings have been notable in recent years.
segments.tr: हाल के वर्षों में मूल्य उतार-चढ़ाव उल्लेखनीय रहे हैं।

segments.src: Lithium prices, for instance, rose sharply during the early 2020s and then fell significantly as new supply arrived, illustrating how volatile these markets can be.
segments.tr: उदाहरण के लिए, 2020 के दशक की शुरुआत में लिथियम की कीमतें तेजी से बढ़ीं और फिर नई आपूर्ति आने के बाद काफी गिर गईं, जो यह दर्शाता है कि ये बाजार कितने अस्थिर हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: For consumers, the effect is usually indirect and delayed, showing up in vehicle pricing, available options or waiting times rather than as a line item on a sticker.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ताओं के लिए, प्रभाव आमतौर पर अप्रत्यक्ष और विलंबित होता है, जो स्टिकर पर लाइन आइटम के बजाय वाहन मूल्य निर्धारण, उपलब्ध विकल्पों या प्रतीक्षा समय में दिखाई देता है।

segments.src: ## Why defense planners care
segments.tr: ## रक्षा योजनाकार क्यों परवाह करते हैं

segments.src: Modern military equipment depends on high-performance magnets, specialty alloys and electronic components.
segments.tr: आधुनिक सैन्य उपकरण उच्च प्रदर्शन वाले चुम्बकों, विशेष मिश्र धातुओं और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक घटकों पर निर्भर करते हैं।

segments.src: Defense officials in several countries have flagged that relying on a limited set of foreign suppliers for these inputs is a vulnerability.
segments.tr: कई देशों के रक्षा अधिकारियों ने झंडा फहराया है कि इन इनपुट के लिए विदेशी आपूर्तिकर्ताओं के सीमित सेट पर निर्भर रहना एक कमजोरी है।

segments.src: This is one reason that mineral policy has moved from the trade desk to national security discussions, and why some defense budgets now include support for domestic processing and magnet production.
segments.tr: यह एक कारण है कि खनिज नीति व्यापार डेस्क से राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा चर्चाओं में चली गई है, और क्यों कुछ रक्षा बजटों में अब घरेलू प्रसंस्करण और चुंबक उत्पादन के लिए समर्थन शामिल है।

segments.src: ## Tech supply chains and the semiconductor connection
segments.tr: ## तकनीक आपूर्ति श्रृंखला और सेमीकंडक्टर कनेक्शन

segments.src: Chipmaking is a global relay race involving design, materials, equipment, fabrication and packaging across many countries.
segments.tr: चिपमेकिंग एक वैश्विक रिले रेस है जिसमें कई देशों में डिजाइन, सामग्री, उपकरण, निर्माण और पैकेजिंग शामिल है।

segments.src: Specialty metals and gases form only a small part of the finished product's cost, but a shortage of a single input can halt a production line.
segments.tr: विशेष धातुएं और गैसें तैयार उत्पाद की लागत का केवल एक छोटा सा हिस्सा बनती हैं, लेकिन एक इनपुट की कमी उत्पादन लाइन को रोक सकती है।

segments.src: That is why technology companies are mapping their suppliers more deeply, qualifying second sources and holding larger inventories of key materials than they did a decade ago.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि प्रौद्योगिकी कंपनियां अपने आपूर्तिकर्ताओं को अधिक गहराई से मैप कर रही हैं, दूसरे स्रोतों को अर्हता प्राप्त कर रही हैं और एक दशक पहले की तुलना में प्रमुख सामग्रियों की बड़ी इन्वेंट्री रख रही हैं।

segments.src: ## The trade-offs: environment, cost and community
segments.tr: ## ट्रेड-ऑफ़: पर्यावरण, लागत और समुदाय

segments.src: Expanding mining and processing is not a simple fix.
segments.tr: खनन और प्रसंस्करण का विस्तार करना कोई साधारण सुधार नहीं है।

segments.src: Mining can affect water, land and local communities, and rare earth processing involves chemicals and sometimes low-level radioactive byproducts that must be managed responsibly.
segments.tr: खनन पानी, भूमि और स्थानीय समुदायों को प्रभावित कर सकता है, और दुर्लभ पृथ्वी प्रसंस्करण में रसायन और कभी-कभी निम्न-स्तरीय रेडियोधर्मी उप-उत्पाद शामिल होते हैं जिन्हें जिम्मेदारी से प्रबंधित किया जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: Labor and safety conditions in some regions, including artisanal cobalt mining, have drawn scrutiny.
segments.tr: शिल्प कौशल कोबाल्ट खनन सहित कुछ क्षेत्रों में श्रम और सुरक्षा स्थितियों ने जांच आकर्षित की है।

segments.src: Many buyers now ask for traceability and responsible-sourcing standards, which can raise costs but also reduce reputational and regulatory risk.
segments.tr: कई खरीदार अब ट्रैसेबिलिटी और जिम्मेदार सोर्सिंग मानकों की मांग करते हैं, जिससे लागत बढ़ सकती है लेकिन प्रतिष्ठित और नियामक जोखिम भी कम हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: There is also a cost question.
segments.tr: लागत का सवाल भी है।

segments.src: Production in new locations may be more expensive than in established hubs, and some projects depend on subsidies, price floors or guaranteed purchases to be viable.
segments.tr: नए स्थानों में उत्पादन स्थापित केंद्रों की तुलना में अधिक महंगा हो सकता है, और कुछ परियोजनाएं व्यवहार्य होने के लिए सब्सिडी, मूल्य फर्श या गारंटीकृत खरीद पर निर्भर करती हैं।

segments.src: How much consumers and taxpayers are willing to pay for supply security is an ongoing policy debate.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ता और करदाता आपूर्ति सुरक्षा के लिए कितना भुगतान करने को तैयार हैं, यह एक चल रही नीतिगत बहस है।

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## क्या देखना है

segments.src: - **Policy announcements:** New export rules, licensing changes and trade agreements can shift supply expectations quickly.
segments.tr: - **Policy announcements:** नए निर्यात नियम, लाइसेंसिंग परिवर्तन और व्यापार समझौते आपूर्ति की उम्मीदों को जल्दी से बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Project milestones:** Whether announced mines and refineries actually reach production on schedule.
segments.tr: - **Project milestones:** क्या घोषित खानों और रिफाइनरियों वास्तव में समय पर उत्पादन तक पहुंचती हैं।

segments.src: - **Recycling rates and technology shifts:** Progress in battery recycling and in magnet designs that use less of the scarcest materials.
segments.tr: - **Recycling rates and technology shifts:** बैटरी रीसाइक्लिंग में और चुंबक डिजाइनों में प्रगति जो सबसे दुर्लभ सामग्रियों का कम उपयोग करती है।

segments.src: - **Price signals:** Sustained moves in rare earth, lithium, cobalt or graphite prices often reflect changes in supply risk or demand.
segments.tr: - **Price signals:** दुर्लभ पृथ्वी, लिथियम, कोबाल्ट या ग्रेफाइट की कीमतों में निरंतर चाल अक्सर आपूर्ति जोखिम या मांग में बदलाव को दर्शाती है।

segments.src: - **Public and private stockpile plans:** Funding decisions and purchasing programs that indicate how seriously governments view the risk.
segments.tr: - **Public and private stockpile plans:** वित्तपोषण निर्णय और खरीद कार्यक्रम जो दर्शाते हैं कि सरकारें जोखिम को कितनी गंभीरता से देखती हैं।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## सबसे नीचे की बात

segments.src: Critical minerals are small in volume compared with oil or steel, but their influence on modern industry is outsized.
segments.tr: तेल या स्टील की तुलना में महत्वपूर्ण खनिज मात्रा में छोटे हैं, लेकिन आधुनिक उद्योग पर उनका प्रभाव बड़ा है।

segments.src: The same few materials link the car in your driveway, the phone in your pocket and the equipment that defends a country.
segments.tr: वही कुछ सामग्रियां आपके रास्ते में कार, आपकी जेब में फोन और किसी देश की रक्षा करने वाले उपकरणों को जोड़ती हैं।

segments.src: Because their supply is concentrated, they have become a lever in trade policy and a focus of national planning.
segments.tr: चूंकि उनकी आपूर्ति केंद्रित है, वे व्यापार नीति में एक लीवर और राष्ट्रीय योजना का केंद्र बन गए हैं।

segments.src: Diversifying that supply will take years, and the path will involve difficult choices about cost, environmental impact and international cooperation.
segments.tr: उस आपूर्ति में विविधता लाने में वर्षों लगेंगे, और पथ में लागत, पर्यावरणीय प्रभाव और अंतरराष्ट्रीय सहयोग के बारे में कठिन विकल्प शामिल होंगे।

segments.tr: *यह लेख केवल सामान्य सूचना के उद्देश्यों के लिए प्रदान किया गया है और इसमें निवेश, वित्तीय या नीतिगत सलाह शामिल नहीं है।

segments.tr: बाजार की स्थिति और सरकारी नीतियां अक्सर बदलती रहती हैं; नवीनतम जानकारी के लिए कृपया आधिकारिक स्रोतों से परामर्श लें।*

es.title: Los metales detrás de las máquinas: por qué las tierras raras y los minerales críticos son un punto de presión geopolítica

segments.src: Every electric car, wind turbine, smartphone and guided missile contains materials most people never think about.
segments.tr: Cada coche eléctrico, turbina eólica, teléfono inteligente y misil guiado contiene materiales en los que la mayoría de la gente nunca piensa.

segments.src: Rare earth elements, lithium, cobalt, graphite, gallium and a handful of other critical minerals sit deep inside modern supply chains.
segments.tr: Los elementos de tierras raras, el litio, el cobalto, el grafito, el galio y un puñado de otros minerales críticos se encuentran en lo más profundo de las cadenas de suministro modernas.

segments.src: Because production and processing of many of them are concentrated in just a few countries, they have become a recurring point of tension in trade policy and national security planning.
segments.tr: Debido a que la producción y el procesamiento de muchos de ellos se concentran en solo unos pocos países, se han convertido en un punto recurrente de tensión en la política comercial y la planificación de la seguridad nacional.

segments.src: ## What are "critical minerals" and rare earths?
segments.tr: ## ¿Qué son los "minerales críticos" y las tierras raras?

segments.src: "Critical minerals" is a policy label, not a scientific category.
segments.tr: "Minerales críticos" es una etiqueta política, no una categoría científica.

segments.src: Governments, including the United States, the European Union, Japan and Australia, maintain lists of materials that are both important to their economies and vulnerable to supply disruption.
segments.tr: Los gobiernos, incluidos los de Estados Unidos, la Unión Europea, Japón y Australia, mantienen listas de materiales que son importantes para sus economías y vulnerables a las interrupciones del suministro.

segments.src: The lists differ, but they commonly include lithium, cobalt, nickel, graphite, manganese, gallium, germanium and the group known as rare earth elements.
segments.tr: Las listas difieren, pero comúnmente incluyen litio, cobalto, níquel, grafito, manganeso, galio, germanio y el grupo conocido como elementos de tierras raras.

segments.src: Despite the name, rare earths are not especially scarce in the Earth's crust.
segments.tr: A pesar del nombre, las tierras raras no son especialmente escasas en la corteza terrestre.

segments.src: The challenge is that they are rarely found in concentrations that are easy and economical to mine, and separating them from one another is a complex, chemically intensive process that can generate significant waste.
segments.tr: El desafío es que rara vez se encuentran en concentraciones que sean fáciles y económicas de extraer, y separarlas unas de otras es un proceso complejo e intensivo en químicos que puede generar una cantidad significativa de residuos.

segments.src: ## Where they show up in everyday products
segments.tr: ## Dónde aparecen en los productos cotidianos

segments.src: - **Magnets:** Neodymium and praseodymium are used in high-strength permanent magnets. These appear in electric vehicle motors, wind turbine generators, hard drives, headphones and many industrial robots. Dysprosium and terbium are added to help magnets withstand heat.
segments.tr: - **Imanes:** El neodimio y el praseodimio se utilizan en imanes permanentes de alta resistencia. Estos aparecen en motores de vehículos eléctricos, generadores de turbinas eólicas, discos duros, auriculares y muchos robots industriales. El disprosio y el terbio se añaden para ayudar a los imanes a soportar el calor.

segments.src: - **Batteries:** Lithium, nickel, cobalt, manganese and graphite are central to most lithium-ion batteries, which power vehicles, laptops, phones and grid storage systems.
segments.tr: - **Baterías:** El litio, el níquel, el cobalto, el manganeso y el grafito son fundamentales para la mayoría de las baterías de iones de litio, que alimentan vehículos, ordenadores portátiles, teléfonos y sistemas de almacenamiento en red.

segments.src: - **Chips and electronics:** Gallium and germanium are used in certain semiconductors, power electronics, fiber optics and infrared sensors. Many other specialty metals play smaller but essential roles in manufacturing.
segments.tr: - **Chips y electrónica:** El galio y el germanio se utilizan en ciertos semiconductores, electrónica de potencia, fibra óptica y sensores infrarrojos. Muchos otros metales especializados desempeñan papeles más pequeños pero esenciales en la fabricación.

segments.src: - **Defense systems:** Radar, sonar, precision guidance, jet engines and communications equipment rely on specialty magnets and alloys.
segments.tr: - **Sistemas de defensa:** El radar, el sónar, el guiado de precisión, los motores de reacción y los equipos de comunicación dependen de imanes y aleaciones especializados.

segments.src: ## Why concentration matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué importa la concentración

segments.src: The key issue is not only who mines these materials, but who refines them.
segments.tr: El problema clave no es solo quién extrae estos materiales, sino quién los refina.

segments.src: Mining may be spread across several countries, yet a large share of processing capacity for many minerals, especially rare earth separation and magnet manufacturing, has been concentrated in China, according to analyses from the International Energy Agency and other agencies.
segments.tr: La minería puede estar repartida en varios países, pero una gran parte de la capacidad de procesamiento de muchos minerales, especialmente la separación de tierras raras y la fabricación de imanes, se ha concentrado en China, según los análisis de la Agencia Internacional de Energía y otros organismos.

segments.src: Other pieces of the chain are concentrated elsewhere: the Democratic Republic of the Congo supplies a large portion of the world's cobalt, and Indonesia has become the leading nickel producer.
segments.tr: Otras partes de la cadena se concentran en otros lugares: la República Democrática del Congo suministra una gran parte del cobalto mundial e Indonesia se ha convertido en el principal productor de níquel.

segments.src: When so much of a supply chain depends on a small number of countries or facilities, any disruption can ripple outward.
segments.tr: Cuando gran parte de una cadena de suministro depende de un pequeño número de países o instalaciones, cualquier interrupción puede propagarse hacia el exterior.

segments.src: That disruption might come from a trade dispute, a policy change, a natural disaster, a labor problem or a political conflict.
segments.tr: Esa interrupción podría provenir de una disputa comercial, un cambio de política, un desastre natural, un problema laboral o un conflicto político.

segments.src: Even the possibility of disruption can push companies and governments to rethink how they source materials.
segments.tr: Incluso la posibilidad de una interrupción puede empujar a las empresas y a los gobiernos a reconsiderar cómo obtienen los materiales.

segments.src: ## Export controls: a policy tool with consequences
segments.tr: ## Controles a la exportación: una herramienta política con consecuencias

segments.src: Export controls restrict or require licenses for shipments of certain goods or technologies.
segments.tr: Los controles a la exportación restringen o exigen licencias para los envíos de determinados bienes o tecnologías.

segments.src: In recent years, several countries have introduced or expanded controls on minerals and related processing technology.
segments.tr: En los últimos años, varios países han introducido o ampliado los controles sobre los minerales y la tecnología de procesamiento relacionada.

segments.src: China, for example, has applied licensing requirements to exports of gallium, germanium, graphite and some rare earth products and magnets.
segments.tr: China, por ejemplo, ha aplicado requisitos de licencia a las exportaciones de galio, germanio, grafito y algunos productos de tierras raras e imanes.

segments.src: Other governments have used their own controls on advanced chips and manufacturing equipment, which in turn has shaped the broader trade debate.
segments.tr: Otros gobiernos han utilizado sus propios controles sobre chips avanzados y equipos de fabricación, lo que a su vez ha dado forma al debate comercial más amplio.

segments.src: Officials who impose such rules typically cite national security, environmental protection or compliance with international obligations.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios que imponen tales normas suelen citar la seguridad nacional, la protección ambiental o el cumplimiento de las obligaciones internacionales.

segments.src: Importing countries and manufacturers often view them as a source of uncertainty.
segments.tr: Los países importadores y los fabricantes a menudo los ven como una fuente de incertidumbre.

segments.src: Whatever the motive, the practical effect is that buyers may face longer lead times, paperwork, higher prices or a need to find alternative suppliers.
segments.tr: Cualquiera que sea el motivo, el efecto práctico es que los compradores pueden enfrentarse a plazos de entrega más largos, trámites burocráticos, precios más altos o la necesidad de encontrar proveedores alternativos.

segments.src: The details of these measures change over time, so readers following the topic should check current government announcements.
segments.tr: Los detalles de estas medidas cambian con el tiempo, por lo que los lectores que sigan el tema deben consultar los anuncios gubernamentales actuales.

segments.src: ## Stockpiling and strategic reserves
segments.tr: ## Almacenamiento y reservas estratégicas

segments.src: Stockpiling is an old idea that is getting new attention.
segments.tr: El almacenamiento es una vieja idea que está recibiendo una nueva atención.

segments.src: Japan has long maintained reserves of rare metals through a government-backed agency.
segments.tr: Japón ha mantenido durante mucho tiempo reservas de metales raros a través de una agencia respaldada por el gobierno.

segments.src: The United States keeps a National Defense Stockpile, and the European Union has discussed building strategic reserves and coordinating purchases.
segments.tr: Estados Unidos mantiene una reserva de defensa nacional y la Unión Europea ha discutido la creación de reservas estratégicas y la coordinación de compras.

segments.src: Several governments have also considered or launched programs to fund domestic inventories of the materials most important to defense and clean energy.
segments.tr: Varios gobiernos también han considerado o lanzado programas para financiar inventarios nacionales de los materiales más importantes para la defensa y la energía limpia.

segments.src: Stockpiles can cushion short-term shocks, but they have limits.
segments.tr: Las reservas pueden amortiguar las perturbaciones a corto plazo, pero tienen límites.

segments.src: Storing materials costs money, some products degrade or become outdated, and a reserve cannot replace a long-term supply chain.
segments.tr: Almacenar materiales cuesta dinero, algunos productos se degradan o quedan obsoletos, y una reserva no puede reemplazar una cadena de suministro a largo plazo.

segments.src: Analysts generally describe stockpiles as one tool among several rather than a complete solution.
segments.tr: Los analistas suelen describir las reservas como una herramienta entre varias en lugar de una solución completa.

segments.src: ## New mining deals and the race to diversify
segments.tr: ## Nuevos acuerdos mineros y la carrera por la diversificación

segments.src: Governments and companies are pursuing partnerships to broaden supply.
segments.tr: Los gobiernos y las empresas buscan asociaciones para ampliar el suministro.

segments.src: Examples of the trend include:
segments.tr: Los ejemplos de esta tendencia incluyen:

segments.src: - **Government agreements:** The United States, the EU, Japan, Australia, Canada and others have signed memoranda and frameworks on critical minerals cooperation, sometimes alongside financing and shared standards.
segments.tr: - **Acuerdos gubernamentales:** Estados Unidos, la UE, Japón, Australia, Canadá y otros han firmado memorandos y marcos sobre cooperación en minerales críticos, a veces junto con financiación y normas compartidas.

segments.src: - **Investment in new projects:** Mines and processing plants are being developed or expanded in Australia, Canada, the United States, parts of Africa and Latin America, and elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Inversión en nuevos proyectos:** Se están desarrollando o ampliando minas y plantas de procesamiento en Australia, Canadá, Estados Unidos, partes de África y América Latina, y otros lugares.

segments.src: - **Offtake agreements and public financing:** Automakers and manufacturers have signed long-term purchase contracts, while public lenders and development banks have backed projects that private markets might consider too risky.
segments.tr: - **Acuerdos de adquisición y financiación pública:** Los fabricantes de automóviles y otros fabricantes han firmado contratos de compra a largo plazo, mientras que los prestamistas públicos y los bancos de desarrollo han respaldado proyectos que los mercados privados podrían considerar demasiado arriesgados.

segments.src: - **Recycling and substitution:** Companies are working on recovering metals from used batteries and magnets, and engineers are designing motors and batteries that use fewer constrained materials.
segments.tr: - **Reciclaje y sustitución:** Las empresas están trabajando en la recuperación de metales de baterías e imanes usados, y los ingenieros están diseñando motores y baterías que utilizan menos materiales limitados.

segments.src: Building a new mine or refinery is slow.
segments.tr: Construir una nueva mina o refinería es lento.

segments.src: It can take a decade or more to move from discovery to production, with permitting, financing, community consultation and environmental review along the way.
segments.tr: Puede llevar una década o más pasar del descubrimiento a la producción, con permisos, financiación, consulta a la comunidad y revisión ambiental en el camino.

segments.src: That timeline means diversification is a long-term effort, and near-term supply can remain tight even when new projects are announced.
segments.tr: Ese calendario significa que la diversificación es un esfuerzo a largo plazo, y el suministro a corto plazo puede seguir siendo ajustado incluso cuando se anuncian nuevos proyectos.

segments.src: ## How this reaches car prices
segments.tr: ## Cómo llega esto a los precios de los automóviles

segments.src: Battery packs represent a large share of the cost of an electric vehicle, and magnet-equipped motors are used in most of them.
segments.tr: Los paquetes de baterías representan una gran parte del costo de un vehículo eléctrico, y los motores equipados con imanes se utilizan en la mayoría de ellos.

segments.src: Gasoline and hybrid vehicles use these materials too, in sensors, motors, speakers and power steering systems.
segments.tr: Los vehículos de gasolina e híbridos también utilizan estos materiales en sensores, motores, altavoces y sistemas de dirección asistida.

segments.src: When mineral prices rise or supply tightens, manufacturers may absorb some of the cost, pass it on to buyers, redesign components or slow production.
segments.tr: Cuando los precios de los minerales suben o el suministro se reduce, los fabricantes pueden absorber parte del costo, trasladarlo a los compradores, rediseñar componentes o ralentizar la producción.

segments.src: Price swings have been notable in recent years.
segments.tr: Las fluctuaciones de precios han sido notables en los últimos años.

segments.src: Lithium prices, for instance, rose sharply during the early 2020s and then fell significantly as new supply arrived, illustrating how volatile these markets can be.
segments.tr: Los precios del litio, por ejemplo, aumentaron drásticamente a principios de la década de 2020 y luego cayeron significativamente a medida que llegaba nueva oferta, lo que ilustra cuán volátiles pueden ser estos mercados.

segments.src: For consumers, the effect is usually indirect and delayed, showing up in vehicle pricing, available options or waiting times rather than as a line item on a sticker.
segments.tr: Para los consumidores, el efecto suele ser indirecto y retrasado, manifestándose en el precio de los vehículos, las opciones disponibles o los tiempos de espera en lugar de aparecer como una partida separada en la etiqueta.

segments.src: ## Why defense planners care
segments.tr: ## Por qué se preocupan los planificadores de defensa

segments.src: Modern military equipment depends on high-performance magnets, specialty alloys and electronic components.
segments.tr: El equipo militar moderno depende de imanes de alto rendimiento, aleaciones especiales y componentes electrónicos.

segments.src: Defense officials in several countries have flagged that relying on a limited set of foreign suppliers for these inputs is a vulnerability.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios de defensa de varios países han señalado que depender de un conjunto limitado de proveedores extranjeros para estos insumos es una vulnerabilidad.

segments.src: This is one reason that mineral policy has moved from the trade desk to national security discussions, and why some defense budgets now include support for domestic processing and magnet production.
segments.tr: Esta es una de las razones por las cuales la política minera ha pasado del departamento de comercio a las discusiones sobre seguridad nacional, y por qué algunos presupuestos de defensa ahora incluyen apoyo para el procesamiento nacional y la producción de imanes.

segments.src: ## Tech supply chains and the semiconductor connection
segments.tr: ## Cadenas de suministro tecnológico y la conexión con los semiconductores

segments.src: Chipmaking is a global relay race involving design, materials, equipment, fabrication and packaging across many countries.
segments.tr: La fabricación de chips es una carrera de relevos global que involucra diseño, materiales, equipos, fabricación y empaquetado en muchos países.

segments.src: Specialty metals and gases form only a small part of the finished product's cost, but a shortage of a single input can halt a production line.
segments.tr: Los metales y gases especializados constituyen solo una pequeña parte del costo del producto terminado, pero la escasez de un solo insumo puede detener una línea de producción.

segments.src: That is why technology companies are mapping their suppliers more deeply, qualifying second sources and holding larger inventories of key materials than they did a decade ago.
segments.tr: Es por eso que las empresas tecnológicas están mapeando a sus proveedores más a fondo, cualificando a segundas fuentes y manteniendo mayores inventarios de materiales clave que hace una década.

segments.src: ## The trade-offs: environment, cost and community
segments.tr: ## Las compensaciones: medio ambiente, costo y comunidad

segments.src: Expanding mining and processing is not a simple fix.
segments.tr: Ampliar la minería y el procesamiento no es una solución sencilla.

segments.src: Mining can affect water, land and local communities, and rare earth processing involves chemicals and sometimes low-level radioactive byproducts that must be managed responsibly.
segments.tr: La minería puede afectar el agua, la tierra y las comunidades locales, y el procesamiento de tierras raras implica químicos y, a veces, subproductos radiactivos de baja intensidad que deben gestionarse de manera responsable.

segments.src: Labor and safety conditions in some regions, including artisanal cobalt mining, have drawn scrutiny.
segments.tr: Las condiciones laborales y de seguridad en algunas regiones, incluida la minería artesanal de cobalto, han atraído escrutinio.

segments.src: Many buyers now ask for traceability and responsible-sourcing standards, which can raise costs but also reduce reputational and regulatory risk.
segments.tr: Muchos compradores ahora solicitan trazabilidad y normas de abastecimiento responsable, lo que puede aumentar los costos pero también reducir el riesgo reputacional y regulatorio.

segments.src: There is also a cost question.
segments.tr: También hay una cuestión de costos.

segments.src: Production in new locations may be more expensive than in established hubs, and some projects depend on subsidies, price floors or guaranteed purchases to be viable.
segments.tr: La producción en nuevas ubicaciones puede ser más cara que en centros establecidos, y algunos proyectos dependen de subsidios, precios mínimos o compras garantizadas para ser viables.

segments.src: How much consumers and taxpayers are willing to pay for supply security is an ongoing policy debate.
segments.tr: Cuánto están dispuestos a pagar los consumidores y contribuyentes por la seguridad del suministro es un debate político en curso.

segments.src: ## What to watch
segments.tr: ## Qué observar

segments.src: - **Policy announcements:** New export rules, licensing changes and trade agreements can shift supply expectations quickly.
segments.tr: - **Anuncios de políticas:** Las nuevas normas de exportación, los cambios en las licencias y los acuerdos comerciales pueden alterar rápidamente las expectativas de suministro.

segments.src: - **Project milestones:** Whether announced mines and refineries actually reach production on schedule.
segments.tr: - **Hitos de los proyectos:** Si las minas y refinerías anunciadas realmente alcanzan la producción según lo previsto.

segments.src: - **Recycling rates and technology shifts:** Progress in battery recycling and in magnet designs that use less of the scarcest materials.
segments.tr: - **Tasas de reciclaje y cambios tecnológicos:** El progreso en el reciclaje de baterías y en los diseños de imanes que utilizan menos de los materiales más escasos.

segments.src: - **Price signals:** Sustained moves in rare earth, lithium, cobalt or graphite prices often reflect changes in supply risk or demand.
segments.tr: - **Señales de precios:** Los movimientos sostenidos en los precios de las tierras raras, el litio, el cobalto o el grafito a menudo reflejan cambios en el riesgo de suministro o en la demanda.

segments.src: - **Public and private stockpile plans:** Funding decisions and purchasing programs that indicate how seriously governments view the risk.
segments.tr: - **Planes de reservas públicas y privadas:** Las decisiones de financiación y los programas de compra que indican cuán seriamente consideran los gobiernos el riesgo.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En conclusión

segments.src: Critical minerals are small in volume compared with oil or steel, but their influence on modern industry is outsized.
segments.tr: Los minerales críticos son pequeños en volumen en comparación con el petróleo o el acero, pero su influencia en la industria moderna es desproporcionada.

segments.src: The same few materials link the car in your driveway, the phone in your pocket and the equipment that defends a country.
segments.tr: Los mismos pocos materiales vinculan el coche en tu entrada, el teléfono en tu bolsillo y el equipo que defiende a un país.

segments.src: Because their supply is concentrated, they have become a lever in trade policy and a focus of national planning.
segments.tr: Debido a que su suministro está concentrado, se han convertido en una palanca en la política comercial y en el foco de la planificación nacional.

segments.src: Diversifying that supply will take years, and the path will involve difficult choices about cost, environmental impact and international cooperation.
segments.tr: Diversificar ese suministro llevará años, y el camino implicará decisiones difíciles sobre el costo, el impacto ambiental y la cooperación internacional.
